pitch: Passive listening tests can show that a brain still processes speech without asking the patient to do anything, which marks patients worth a full follow-up scan.

But every new story needs its own 12-15 healthy volunteers scanned on it, in that language. StillHere needs none: Meta's TRIBE v2 stands in for them, and every reading is measured against the person's own resting brain.

lpp.quote: With zero matched volunteers, both readouts picked up English and French listeners as a group, and the language readout followed the real story over a word-shuffled one.
